# OS.MECHPLAST SRLS

OS.MECHPLAST SRLS is a CNC contract manufacturing company in Ala (TN), Italy.

Website: https://osmechplast.com/
Email: info@osmechplast.com
Address: Via Strada Romana n. 19, 38061 Ala (TN), Italy

## Core Offer

- CNC turned parts to customer drawing
- Turn-milled CNC parts to customer drawing
- Prototypes, single parts, small batches, medium batches and recurring series when technically feasible
- Materials currently described on the website: plastics, aluminium and machinable steels

## Machines

- 2 x Hyundai WIA L210LMA CNC turning centers
- 1 x Hyundai WIA HD2200SY with Y-axis and sub-spindle
- Breuning IRCO ILS-MUK bar loader on the HD2200SY

## Important Boundaries

- The website must not claim ISO 9001 certification unless it is officially confirmed.
- The website must not invent tolerances, delivery times, customer references, material certificates or industry approvals.
- Technical feasibility depends on drawing, material, tolerances, quantity and requested schedule.
- Binding offers are prepared after technical review, not by automatic price calculation.
